items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Lucas. And I kept that for a long time.

ctx.x: When the red light would go on, then you start to record it. Now the man in the back that's recording it, there was a little light thread would come off of that disc and it would pile up and then you'd have to wrap it up and take it off and throw it on the floor. And that was one continuous operation until you cut the disc. And then the lights would go on and nobody said a word, nothing dropped on the floor, you couldn't breathe too hard. That's right. Today it's a lot different.
That's the way it was now we made our first records. We were so crazy about the records we even saved that little, that little shave in it, Lucas. And I kept that for a long time.
Look at that I made records, you don't believe it, look at this other thing.
